name: 方程装配
io: 模式、输入、冻结图/参数→R(z;u,θ,G)=0及维度

en.name: Equation assembly
en.io: Mode, inputs, and frozen graph/parameters → R(z;u,θ,G)=0 and dimensions

name: 初值和预条件
io: 显式结果或合法历史快照→初值与预条件器

en.name: Initialization and preconditioning
en.io: Explicit results or valid historical snapshots → initial guess and preconditioner

name: 有界前向求解
io: 残差算子→近似解、迭代数、残差及终止原因

en.name: Bounded forward solve
en.io: Residual operator → approximate solution, iteration count, residual, and termination reason

name: 残差与条件诊断
io: 迭代轨迹→容差判定、数值状态与适用的误差界

en.name: Residual and conditioning diagnostics
en.io: Iteration trajectory → tolerance assessment, numerical status, and applicable error bounds

name: 梯度接口
io: 近似根、损失梯度→隐式或展开梯度及其精度记录

en.name: Gradient interface
en.io: Approximate root and loss gradient → implicit or unrolled gradients and accuracy records

name: 接受与失败路径
io: 近似解/诊断→接受、退回显式基线或 unknown

en.name: Acceptance and failure paths
en.io: Approximate solution/diagnostics → acceptance, return to explicit baseline, or unknown

name: 预测快照与创新
io: 观测前预测＋后到结果→配对误差信号

en.name: Prediction snapshots and innovations
en.io: Pre-observation prediction + later outcome → paired error signal

name: 持续性/漂移诊断
io: 多窗口误差与 QC→原因候选、置信与触发条件

en.name: Persistence/drift diagnostics
en.io: Multi-window errors and QC → candidate causes, confidence, and triggers

name: 结构候选生成
io: 原因与资源→分裂/增宽/加边/专家/不变等候选

name: 参数和状态迁移
io: 旧结构→候选新参数、记忆、掩码与优化器状态

en.name: Parameter and state migration
en.io: Old structure → candidate parameters, memory, masks, and optimizer state

name: 局部训练与竞争
io: 新结果与旧任务回放→父模型/候选性能比较

en.name: Local training and competition
en.io: New outcomes and old-task replay → parent/candidate performance comparison

name: 稳定与等变审核
io: 候选结构→结构、数值、对称性与任务证据

en.name: Stability and equivariance review
en.io: Candidate structure → structural, numerical, symmetry, and task evidence

name: 持久接纳与监测
io: 通过预定门槛的候选→新版本与退化监测

en.name: Persistent acceptance and monitoring
en.io: Candidates passing predefined thresholds → new versions and degradation monitoring

name: 修剪/合并/蒸馏
io: 长期使用和效果记录→压缩版本或撤销候选

en.name: Pruning/merging/distillation
en.io: Long-term usage and effect records → compressed versions or candidate withdrawal
